answer: The oasis schedule is applied in pearl and spiral makes public each instalment. A payout is split thus 25% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2307 identities would post 4829 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
